scope: Union of registry dependencies resolved by both shipped Cargo.lock files, including build, test and target-specific dependencies. This is an overinclusive attribution inventory, not a precise compiled-WASM SBOM. Local path dependencies are covered separately by stellar/licenses and original source headers.
collectionMethod: Read crate archives without executing package code. Verify each archive SHA-256 against Cargo.lock. Preserve matching license, copying, copyright, notice and authors files byte for byte. Upstream supplements, when needed, are explicitly labeled.
